name: Charter Gate: Reviewed Dosage Contract
description: Shows mumei rejecting weakened, narrowed, under-graded, and unpinned dosage repairs.

intro: Step 1: Copy the reviewed dosage project and lock its charter.
Step 2: Compare candidate repairs with the charter and their proof grades.
narrative.before: A repair can verify against a weakened contract or depend on an untrusted shortcut.
narrative.after: The charter gate accepts the correctly proved implementation and rejects weaker, narrower, under-graded, or unpinned candidates.

rejected.headline: Charter Gate: postcondition weakened
follow_up: The candidate verifies against its own weaker contract.
The reviewed dosage bound is still required.

pass.headline: Charter Gate: the proved repair meets the reviewed contract

rejected.headline: Charter Gate: proof grade is below the requirement
Charter Gate: changed charter text is unpinned

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate that mumei accepts a properly proved dosage repair and rejects candidates that weaken or exceed the reviewed charter.
artifact_contracts: The first step copies scenarios/charter_gate_demo/project into {output_dir}/project and writes the charter lock only in that copy.
Every charter check runs from the copied project directory, except the deliberate edit check, which runs from its separate output_dir/project_edit copy.
The weakened-ensures candidate first verifies against its own contract, then the charter check rejects it.
The correct implementation writes charter_gate.proof.json and passes the default G4 charter gate.
The trusted-shortcut implementation writes its own certificate and is rejected below the default Seal Grade.
The changed-charter check reports an unpinned result without changing the source project.
result.json and report.md record charter-gate entries and totals.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: A repair must preserve the reviewed dosage contract and meet the proof-grade requirement.
success_criteria: The candidate with a weakened ensures clause verifies by itself and is rejected as post_weakened.
The candidate with a stronger requires clause is rejected as pre_weakened.
The correctly proved candidate passes the charter check with its certificate.
The trusted-shortcut candidate is rejected as grade_below.
Editing the charter after locking it results in an unpinned rejection.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: each expected outcome is tied to a concrete charter check and the copied project lock.

steps.name: Lock the reviewed dosage charter
artifact_contract: The input project is copied to {output_dir}/project before mumei charter lock runs.
The resulting charter.lock exists only in the output copy.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei charter lock exits 0 and writes the deterministic project lock.

steps.name: Reject a repair that weakens ensures
steps.command: cd {output_dir}/project && {mumei_bin} verify weakened_ensures.mm && {mumei_bin} charter check weakened_ensures.mm --json
artifact_contract: weakened_ensures.mm verifies against its own weaker contract.
The JSON charter report rejects the missing result <= max_dose guarantee.
steps.verifier_gate: The implementation verifies, then mumei charter check exits 1 with post_weakened.

steps.name: Reject a repair that narrows requires
artifact_contract: The JSON charter report rejects the additional max_dose > 0 requirement.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei charter check exits 1 with pre_weakened.

steps.name: Verify the correct dosage repair
artifact_contract: The step records a Claim Book entry for correct.mm and its certificate.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei verify exits 0, verifies clamp_dose, and emits a proof certificate.

steps.name: Accept the correctly proved repair
artifact_contract: The JSON charter report has top-level status pass and records the implementation atom grade.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei charter check exits 0 after refinement and the default G4 evidence gate.

steps.name: Verify the trusted-shortcut dosage repair
artifact_contract: The step records a Claim Book entry for the trusted-shortcut implementation and certificate.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei verify accepts the candidate implementation and writes a proof certificate.

steps.name: Reject proof below the default Seal Grade
artifact_contract: The JSON charter report rejects the trusted-helper dependency below the default G4 threshold.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei charter check exits 1 with grade_below for clamp_dose.

steps.name: Reject an edited, unpinned charter
steps.command: cd {output_dir}/project && rm -rf {output_dir}/project_edit && cp -R {output_dir}/project {output_dir}/project_edit && printf '\n// Deliberate unpinned edit.\n' >> {output_dir}/project_edit/specs/dosage.charter.mm && cd {output_dir}/project_edit && {mumei_bin} charter check correct.mm --json
artifact_contract: The edited project is a separate copy under {output_dir}/project_edit.
The JSON charter report records the lock mismatch and unpinned atom status.
steps.verifier_gate: mumei charter check exits 1 and reports the changed charter as unpinned.
